mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse (warehouse_code, warehouse_name, created_at, updated_at, phone_number, province_code, province_name, province_id, street, address_detail, ward_code, ward_name, ward_id, is_deleted, is_address_default) VALUES (#{warehouse.warehouse_code}, #{warehouse.warehouse_name}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt}, #{warehouse.phone_number}, #{warehouse.province_code}, #{warehouse.province_name}, #{warehouse.province_id}, #{warehouse.street}, #{warehouse.address_detail}, #{warehouse.ward_code}, #{warehouse.ward_name}, #{warehouse.ward_id}, 'false', #{warehouse.address_is_default})
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse SET is_deleted = CASE WHEN #{deleted} = 1 THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT wi.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, wi.sku_id AS skuId, ps.sku_code AS skuCode, ps.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, wi.quantity AS quantity, wi.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM warehouse_inventory wi JOIN warehouse w ON w.id = wi.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 'false' JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.id = wi.sku_id AND ps.is_deleted = 'false' LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ps.product_id WHERE wi.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} ORDER BY p.name, ps.sku_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_sku WHERE id = #{skuId} AND is_deleted = 'false'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO warehouse_inventory (warehouse_id, sku_id, quantity, updated_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE warehouse_inventory SET quantity = quantity + #{delta}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} AND quantity + #{delta} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT quantity FROM warehouse_inventory WHERE warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND sku_id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_inventory_movement (warehouse_id, sku_id, quantity_delta, quantity_after, reason, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{warehouseId}, #{skuId}, #{delta}, #{quantityAfter}, #{reason}, #{createdBy}, NOW())
